title: scripts/pm: fleet roster generator — regenerate the pinned 「车队总表」 issue from seat posts, labels, assignees and PR queries (maintainer's word 2026-10-23)
body:
Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task, the maintainer's words quoted verbatim. Filed from the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (account `os-elon-musk`) by the research thread 车队机制迁往 Projects on the maintainer's word there. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane self-applied under exception 二; grade suggested p3 · S; triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023), in-seat subagent S card: one script `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` (read-only GitHub + one relay `issue_patch` of the roster issue body), self-test with fixtures. The roster issue itself is created once by the seat through the relay and pinned by the maintainer.
## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, project thread 车队机制迁往 Projects, verbatim)

> 我的账户清单不固定的， 20x 周流量用完了，我就会换另外一个账户。 (06:27Z)
> 具体的分配应该是我人工制定的。 (06:27Z)
> 然后是否应该有一张总表能看到哪些账户在负责哪些车道，包括状态等 (06:38Z)
> 或者你不要强调是谁 (11:46Z)
> 你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务，跟踪落地 (12:13Z)

The research memo these cards implement: https://claude.ai/artifact/VFTHWcmKkzbah17UM8KRqm (sections 10, 13; private to the maintainer's account).

## What was measured

- Protocol rule 5 (`cross-repo-coordination.md`) forbids a second tracker, so the table must be a generated view of GitHub facts.
- Every column already exists as a query: seat posts (`label:pm:seat`, 🟢 line 「由 X 账户的项目负责」), `pm:dispatched` + assignee, `needs-user-decision`, open `head:claude/` PRs with ACCEPT/PASS comments, wall notes in seat posts, `updated_at`, `label:pm:mailbox` (label is a sibling devx card).
- Columns wanted: repo · lane · seat · account · in-flight cards · awaiting ruling · awaiting landing · wall note · last activity · mailbox PR.

## Wanted

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --repos objectstack-ai/objectstack,objectstack-ai/objectui,objectstack-ai/hotcrm --json` prints the rows; `--write <issue>` patches the roster issue body through the relay (`issue_patch`), one write, no comments. Deterministic ordering (repo, lane, seat). A footer line names the generation time and the queries used.
- Called by the 总监席's daily digest and after any seat/takeover/handover; the script itself has no schedule.
- `pm:mailbox` PRs excluded from the awaiting-landing column; a seat whose last activity is older than 6 h and whose post has no wall note is flagged 「疑似撞墙」.

## Acceptance

- Self-test with fixture JSON for the three repos passes; `--json` on the live repos lists today's seats (#19287, #6023, hotcrm#1353 among them) with the right accounts.
- One roster issue exists in objectstack, labelled `tracking`, body regenerated by `--write`; `git grep` finds no hand-maintained copy of the table under `.claude/` or `docs/`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "fleet roster pinned issue generated table which account holds which lane seat status in-flight awaiting decision" → 3 hits: #19287 (seat post), #9981 (closed, lane patrol rows), #9140 (closed, queue-steward Routine retired). None is a roster. **New.**

Dedupe words: `fleet-roster.mjs` · `车队总表`.
